description.value: City Centre Community Centre is a publicly operated recreation facility run by the City of Richmond, located at 5900 Minoru Boulevard in the heart of Richmond. As part of Richmond's network of community centres, it offers programs and services to the local community. Touring cyclists passing through central Richmond may find it a useful stop, though specific cyclist-facing amenities are unconfirmed.
